nodes.label: Alembic Migration Rules
nodes.rationale: Autogenerate drafts and humans review, because Alembic does not see a rename — it sees a drop and an add, which on a populated table means silent data loss. Every migration must downgrade; no data and schema migration share a file, because they need different review and fail differently. The DB URL comes from TW_DATABASE_URL, never alembic.ini, so no credential sits in a committed file.

nodes.label: Expand and Contract Migrations
nodes.rationale: Add the new column nullable, backfill, make it NOT NULL, then remove the old one across separate migrations, so old and new application code both work while a deploy is in flight (failure F20).

nodes.label: Autogenerate Drift Test
nodes.rationale: Building the test schema from the real migrations and then asking autogenerate whether it still has anything to say is what stops models and migrations drifting apart — drift that is otherwise discovered in production.

edges.source_location: both are anti-drift gates (.env.example vs models/migrations)
